title: MIDI LOOPBACK
author: irpina
description: An internal MIDI cable for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys: what a MIDI track sends goes back into the unit instead of out, as if it came in on DIN, so a MIDI track can sequence and p-lock the Digitone's own tracks and its master effects (set its CHAN to a synth track's or the FX channel and its CCs to the parameters' CC numbers). LOOP, knob E on the MIDI tracks' TRIG page, switches it per MIDI track and per pattern; the LOOPBACK tile in the Mod Menu (hold a track key) opens the four switches. Applied from the UI task, up to a frame (33 ms) after the step. OS 1.43 and 1.44 (it names no firmware address: its 1.44 port is empty). Needs core-dn1 5.1.
